trails.name: City Creek Trail
trails.description: A favored urban escape that winds through the heart of Pocatello alongside City Creek, passing through forested paths, rocky outcrops, and riparian zones popular for birdwatching.

trails.name: Gibson Jack Trail
trails.description: Part of the larger West Bench Trail System near Pocatello, offering a mix of scenic beauty and multiple route options for hikers of varying experience.

trails.name: Mink Creek Trail
trails.description: A tranquil hike through dense forest alongside Mink Creek, with spots to cool off in the water and a peaceful, shaded atmosphere south of Pocatello.

trails.name: Scout Mountain Trail
trails.description: A steep climb within the Bannock Mountain Range rewarded with panoramic summit views and, in spring and summer, hillsides lined with wildflowers.

trails.name: Bannock Peak Trail
trails.description: A remote, less-crowded climb through dense pine forest leading to sweeping alpine views, with moose and mountain goats occasionally spotted in the surrounding meadows.

trails.name: Mount Moh Trail
trails.description: A short but rewarding climb near Lava Hot Springs through aspen groves and wildflower-filled hillsides, ending in panoramic valley and mountain views.

trails.name: Black Canyon Trail
trails.description: A long, challenging trail near Ririe well suited to a full day of hiking, with options for horseback riding and off-roading along the way.

trails.name: Upper Palisades Lake Trail
trails.description: A scenic backpacking and day-hiking trail leading to Upper Palisades Lake, popular for camping and fishing along the way.

trails.name: Craters of the Moon Trails
trails.forest: Craters of the Moon National Monument & Preserve
trails.description: A network of trails winding through a unique volcanic landscape of lava fields and cinder cones, offering an otherworldly hiking experience.

trails.name: Bell Marsh Creek Trail
trails.description: A scenic one-way trail following Bell Marsh Creek, often ranked among the top hikes near Pocatello for its varied terrain and creekside views.
